# @mgpl-diagnostics/worker-kit

> Background jobs for the MGPL Diagnostics backend (Node.js ≥ 20). Typed job definitions and one queue API over BullMQ on Redis, in-process, or worker-when-available-else-standalone; plus the worker runner. The main entry has no runtime dependencies; bullmq and ioredis are optional peers used only by "/bullmq".

Key facts for agents:
- `defineJob({ name, queue?, process(data, ctx), validate?, attempts = 3, backoffMs = 2000, keepResultsMs = 1h, keepFailedMs, maxBytes, refuseSecrets = true })`.
- `createJobQueue({ backend, jobs })` → `enqueue(job, data, { delayMs? })`, `get(job, id)`, `enqueuer(job)` (mail-kit MailQueue shape), `available()`, `close()`.
- Backends: `inlineBackend({ wait?, onError? })`, `fallbackBackend({ primary, fallback, whenFails?, onFallback? })`, and from "/bullmq" `bullmqBackend({ connection | redisUrl, prefix = "mgpl" })`.
- Worker: `startWorker({ jobs, connection | redisUrl, prefix, concurrency = 4, queues?, onError?, onFailed? })` → `{ queues, workers, close() }`.
- `JobFailure(message, retry = true)`: message shown to clients; `retry: false` fails at once. Other errors → "Job failed" + `onError`.
- `JobInfo`: id, name, queue, state (waiting | delayed | active | completed | failed), attempts, error, result, data, createdAt, finishedAt.
- Errors: `WorkerError.code` = WORKER_UNKNOWN_JOB, WORKER_BAD_DATA, WORKER_DUPLICATE_JOB, WORKER_UNAVAILABLE, WORKER_CLOSED.

- [src/fallback.ts](src/fallback.ts): worker or standalone
- [src/bullmq.ts](src/bullmq.ts): BullMQ backend and worker
